name: Dark Mist
doc: Dark Mist / Poison Mist (Anacondaur's enemy attacks): one emitter per action - a swirl at the caster's mouth, a mist controller throwing a cloud, mist puffs and streams toward the target, puffs round it, the target redrawn wobbling; the damage. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag013_dark_mist.cpp) run on the program's memory.

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Emitter
parts.doc: One per action: the swirl at the caster's mouth at once, the mist controller, the damage, its sound

parts.title: Mist
parts.doc: The mist controller: the cloud, the mist puffs thrown to the target, the streams, the puffs round the target, the target's wobbling overlay

params.label: Sound
params.doc: Played at the emitter's first tick

params.label: Mist from
params.doc: The mist controller from this tick

params.label: Damage at
params.doc: The action's result from this tick

params.label: Puffs until
params.doc: Four mist puffs a tick until this tick of the controller

params.label: Stream 1
params.doc: A stream at this tick...

params.label: Stream 2
params.doc: ...and one at this tick

params.label: Target puffs 1
params.doc: Puffs round the target from this tick...

params.label: Target puffs 2
params.doc: ...and more from this one

params.label: Overlay at
params.doc: The target's wobbling overlay from this tick

params.label: End
params.doc: The controller is done after this tick

params.label: Mist
params.doc: The sprite sequence mist (a flipbook of 24 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Mist b
params.doc: The sprite sequence mist b (a flipbook of 2 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Puff c
params.doc: The sprite sequence puff c (a flipbook of 9 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Puff d
params.doc: The sprite sequence puff d (a flipbook of 10 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Cloud model
params.doc: The prim model cloud (a mesh of 160 vertices, 128 primitives: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))

params.label: Swirl model
params.doc: The prim model swirl (a mesh of 144 vertices, 128 primitives: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))

params.label: Ring table model
params.doc: The prim model ring table (a mesh of 144 vertices, 128 primitives: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))

params.label: Texture file
params.doc: The texture file its loader reads from the magic folder (a name of at most 31 letters)

params.label: Camera track
params.doc: The camera track its setup plays (any length: its offsets are its own)

params.label: Stream vectors
params.doc: Each mist stream variant's direction (x, y, z) (80 bytes: an edited one keeps its length)
